title: Ollama MultimodalWebSurfer crash using Ollama and llama3.2
body:
### What happened?

**Describe the bug**
When running the example of web surfer using ollama with model llama3.2 the `MultimodalWebSurfer `crashes

**To Reproduce**
Run web surfer example provided in README.md with `OllamaChatCompletionClient` and model llama3.2

```python
import asyncio
from autogen_agentchat.agents import UserProxyAgent
from autogen_agentchat.conditions import TextMentionTermination
from autogen_agentchat.teams import RoundRobinGroupChat
from autogen_agentchat.ui import Console
from autogen_ext.models.ollama import OllamaChatCompletionClient
from autogen_ext.agents.web_surfer import MultimodalWebSurfer


async def main() -> None:
    model_client = OllamaChatCompletionClient(model="llama3.2")

    web_surfer = MultimodalWebSurfer(
        "web_surfer", model_client, headless=False, animate_actions=True
    )

    user_proxy = UserProxyAgent("user_proxy")

    termination = TextMentionTermination("exit", sources=["user_proxy"])

    team = RoundRobinGroupChat(
        [web_surfer, user_proxy], termination_condition=termination
    )

    try:
        await Console(
            team.run_stream(
                task="Find information about AutoGen and write a short summary."
            )
        )
    finally:
        await web_surfer.close()
        await model_client.close()


asyncio.run(main())
```

**Expected behavior**
Proceed without errors

**Stack Trace**
```

              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "C:\Users\nicoa\Projects\test\.venv\Lib\site-packages\autogen_ext\agents\web_surfer\_multimodal_web_surfer.py", line 612, in _generate_reply
    response = await self._model_client.create(
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "C:\Users\nicoa\Projects\test\.venv\Lib\site-packages\autogen_ext\models\ollama\_ollama_client.py", line 456, in create
    self._client.chat(  # type: ignore
TypeError: AsyncClient.chat() got an unexpected keyword argument 'tool_choice'
```

linked_prs.title: Filter invalid parameters in Ollama client requests
linked_prs.body:
Remove unrecognized parameters in Ollama API calls.

<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please review https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/docs/Contribute before opening a pull request. -->

<!-- Please add a reviewer to the assignee section when you create a PR. If you don't have the access to it, we will shortly find a reviewer and assign them to your PR. -->

## Why are these changes needed?

This change addresses a compatibility issue where invalid parameters like `tool_choice` were being passed to the Ollama API even if they are not in the valid keyword arguments for Ollama client: https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/blob/685142cf51c2cd41e1dbfaa48a4efbec0cabe396/python/packages/autogen-ext/src/autogen_ext/models/ollama/_ollama_client.py#L84-L86

After the `self._create_args` copy is merged with the `extra_create_args` in the `_process_create_args` method called by the `create` method of the `BaseOllamaChatCompletionClient`, the function `_create_args_from_config` is called, that checks the keyword arguments of the Ollama API call and filters out those not in `OLLAMA_VALID_CREATE_KWARGS_KEYS`.

## Related issue number

Closes #5979

- [x] I've made sure all auto checks have passed.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves an LLM provider (Ollama) and a specific model (llama3.2), and the crash occurs during tool invocation within the `MultimodalWebSurfer` agent system, which aligns with the definition of an agent issue under tool-related and LLM operation issues.
